title: Fortnite pirate token odds vs real life odds
headline: RARER THAN
LIGHTNING?

lines.text: Is Fortnite's pirate token rarer than getting struck by lightning?

lines.note: Average amateur, per par 3 · common estimate

lines.text: The pirate token? One in 137,500 chests.
lines.note: Epic's official rate, per chest · Nov 2026

lines.text: Lightning, in a whole year? One in 1.2 million. So no. Lightning is nine times rarer.
lines.note: US odds of being struck in a given year · NWS: 1 in 1,222,000

lines.text: But here's the catch. For a coin-flip shot at one token, you'd need about 95,000 chests.
lines.note: Chance of at least one token hits 50% at ~95,300 chests

lines.text: And the Powerball jackpot? One in 292 million.
You'd find over 2,000 pirate tokens first.
